name: Believer’s Order
body:
Even if you’re not a cleric, you’ve been ordered as a servant of your god.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Believer’s Boon, character level 3rd, alignment must be within one step of your deity’s.

Benefit(s): You can use the domain power you selected with Believer’s Boon as if you were a cleric of your character level -2, even if you have level in cleric. In addition, you gain the cleric’s aura if you don’t already have it. You must abide by the cleric’s code of conduct and restriction from casting spells of opposed alignments.
